chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Tatarri, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Hanzalah, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'The standing (qamah) and the two standings (qamatain) are the cubit and the two cubits, in the Book of Ali (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ: The Book of Ali (referring to a specific juristic text attributed to Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What is the measured length of standing (qamah) in prayer according to the Book of Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) links the specific measurements of standing (qamah) in prayer to the authoritative 'Book of Ali' (Kitab Ali), highlighting the transmission of legal details from the Prophet's household. It clarifies that the term 'qamah' refers to a single cubit and 'qamatain' to two cubits, establishing the physical extent of the standing posture in salat based on this inherited tradition.
